news.title: BRAT housing programme for Visi Lagenda completed
news.excerpt: AM Management Group has completed its Bina Rumah Atas Tanah programme across sites in Negeri Sembilan and Melaka.
news.content:
AM Management Group has completed the Pembangunan Perumahan Bina Rumah Atas Tanah (BRAT) programme for Visi Lagenda Sdn Bhd.

The contract, valued at RM 1,019,200, ran from June 2023 to June 2025 and covered sites including Taman Hilsa in Port Dickson, Lenggong Ulu, Kuala Pilah, Pulau Gadong and Pantai Siring.

news.title: Housing and shop-office programme under way in Melaka
news.excerpt: Works have started on a RM 1.64 million housing and shop/office programme at four Melaka locations.
news.content:
AM Management Group has started a housing and shop/office development programme valued at RM 1,641,000.

Works cover Taman Kota Laksamana, Melekek in Alor Gajah, Anjung Gapam in Bemban, and Bachang.

news.title: CIDB Grade G5 registration renewed to 2027
news.excerpt: The company's CIDB registration at Grade G5 is valid until June 2027.
news.content: AM Management Group's registration with the Construction Industry Development Board (CIDB) has been renewed at Grade G5 in categories B, CE and ME, effective 14 July 2024 and valid until 21 June 2027.
